subject: Biology
_transcription: Transcribed 2026-10-30 from APUP render p08-p36 (printed pages 3-31). Page map: Q1 p08-p11 (scheme p12, comments p13-p14); Q2 p15-p16 (scheme p17, comments p18-p19); Section B heading + Q3 p20 (scheme p20-p21); Q4 p23 (scheme p24, comments p25); Q5 p25-p26 (scheme p26-p27); Q6 p29 (scheme p30); Q7 p32-p33 (scheme p33); Q8 p35 (scheme p35-p36). p01-p07 are cover/statistics, p37-p39 topics-found-difficult and general suggestions. Structure: Section A (40, attempt all) = Q1 fifteen 1-mark MCQs [15] + Q2 five 5-mark parts; Section B (40, attempt any four) = Q3-Q8, each five parts marked 1+2+2+2+3 = 10. Rows: 15 + 5 + 6x5 = 50; marks checked: Section A 15 + 25 = 40, each Section B question 10. Question numbers run 1-8 unbroken; part numerals (i)-(xv) in Q1 and (i)-(v) in Q2-Q8 checked unbroken against the printed scheme tables. No internal choice (no OR) anywhere. Every question has a MARKING SCHEME block (8 of 8). Examiners' comments checked (text layer, prose only): no accepted-alternative or defective-question remarks beyond what the schemes already list.

Given below is the diagram of a human heart. Read the information below the diagram and fill in the blanks:

*The human heart pumps blood throughout the body. It is the size of a large fist. The heart is located between the lungs in the thoracic cavity. It has four chambers. The heart functions all through the lifespan of a person and is responsible for the survival of the person.*

The heart is enclosed by a membrane called (a) ____________. The ventricles give rise to two large blood vessels called (b) ____________ and (c) ____________. The flaps of the cuspid valves are kept in position by (d) ____________. (e) ____________ arteries supply oxygenated blood to the walls of the heart.

rows.text:
A farmer cultivates a unique species of tomato plants. The two traits selected for breeding were: Colour of the fruits and height of the plants. The farmer initially crosses a homozygous tall plant bearing red fruits **(TTRR)** with a dwarf plant bearing yellow fruits **(ttrr)** and the genotype of all the offsprings of the **F\(_1\)** generation was **TtRr**. Next, he crosses two **F\(_1\)** generation plants **(TtRr)**.
(a) Explain the phenotype of the offsprings of the **F\(_1\)** generation obtained from the initial cross.
(b) Mention the phenotypic ratio of the **F\(_2\)** generation offsprings.
(c) State Mendel’s Law of Independent Assortment.

figure.note: Boxed picture of two tomato plants, captioned 'Tall plant with red fruits' and 'Dwarf plant with yellow fruits'.
